# dsh-macos-tap-fix
A small workaround plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh / dsh-tauri) on macOS.
> **Temporary.** Remove it once the WebKit fix ships.
## Symptom
On macOS, with an input method (e.g. Japanese, Chinese) active and an editable element focused (such
as the chat input), the first **Tap-to-Click** on a button does nothing; a second tap is needed. Pr
essing the trackpad down, or using Firefox, works.
## Cause
WebKit Bug 219670: the tap's `mouseup` can be delivered **before** its `mousedown`, so the `click` i
s lost. A fix is proposed in WebKit/WebKit#76581. It affects Safari and WKWebView apps, including ds
A fix is proposed in WebKit/WebKit#76581. It affects Safari and WKWebView apps, including dsh-tauri.
## What this plugin does
Browser-side only, macOS only. When a `mouseup` arrives with no preceding `mousedown`, it waits 40 m
s; if no `click` reached that element, it dispatches one, and ignores the late `mousedown`. Normal c
licks are untouched.

## Caveats
- It infers broken event order and synthesizes a click, so edge cases are possible. Use at your own

risk.
- Only verified by hand on macOS 26.5.1 with Google Japanese Input.

r restarting the app.
